name: Sovereign AI Control Plane
audience: Enterprises, MSPs, and private-AI appliance vendors with fleets of local AI boxes (edge, branch, client sites).
pain: You sold 50 private AI boxes. Now who watches them? Each one drifts, breaks, or fails compliance silently. Spreadsheets and SSH don't scale. You need one pane of glass: every box scored, remediated, and compliance-attested — automatically, privately.
offer: Sovereign AI Control Plane is the enterprise platform that turns your fleet of private AI boxes into one monitored, scored, remediated, and compliance-attested fleet. Every node feeds a single live operational dashboard — revenue leverage, system productivity, predictive signals, profit/financial modelling, and strategic outlook, all updating in real time. Multi-tenant orgs, per-node Sovereign Ops Score + AI Box Doctor remediation + Private AI Readiness Audit, fleet aggregation, SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR attestation export, RBAC, and white-label. Built on the exact engines already running our own 3xGPU sovereign fleet.
dashboard_features: Revenue leverage: ready products, verified purchases, scored leads, idle credits
System productivity: fleet service health, GPU lanes, operator inbox, CVE triage
Predictive: lead-to-buy conversion, credit burn-down runway, bottleneck detection
Profit/financial: addressable vs realized revenue, automation net, investment payback
Strategic & competitive outlook: moat, competitive watch, near-term bets, product mix
headline: One pane of glass for your entire private-AI fleet — scored, fixed, and compliance-attested.
founding_cohort: First 10 enterprise customers: $5k/yr locked + first 25 nodes free forever. Standard rises to $8k/yr.
cross_sell: The fleet layer. Single boxes use Sovereign Ops Score / AI Box Doctor / Private AI Readiness Audit; fleets need the Control Plane.
